fields.options:
Body Text and Closing Text Example

We have noticed that the following payments, totaling {{ currency }} {{ total_outstanding }}, are overdue:
    {% for row in overdue_payments %}
  • Invoice {{ row.sales_invoice }}: {{ currency }} {{ row.outstanding }}, due on {{ row.due_date }}.
    • {% endfor %}
Please pay the amount due immediately to avoid any further dunning cost.

How to get fieldnames

The fieldnames you can use in your template are the fields in the document. You can find out the fields of any documents via Setup > Customize Form View and selecting Dunning or Overdue Payment for the payment rows

Templating

Templates are compiled using the Jinja Templating Language. To learn more about Jinja, read this documentation.
